# Pinnacle Blooms Centre Entity Reference | 58 Source Records

A source-linked crosswalk for 58 Pinnacle Blooms centre entity records: official centre URLs, 56 complete HFR identifiers, dated workflow labels and two sitemap canonical gaps.

Central phone and WhatsApp: +91 9100 181 181

Email: care@pinnacleblooms.org

Records: 58 = 56 complete HFR identifier records + KGV and NCC official sitemap labels. This is not a count of current operating centres.

Official centre sitemap observed 23 September 2026: https://www.pinnacleblooms.org/sitemaps/centres.xml

HFR account observation: 2026-09-19

Boundary: All 56 complete identifiers were matched to the authenticated NHPR / ABDM facility-manager dashboard on 19 September 2026. Statuses are the exact workflow labels displayed on that date, not a live feed or a clinical-quality rating. Approved, Submitted, Query Raised, Query Resolved and Rejected are kept distinct. One masked Draft is separate. Original workbook RS flags are preserved and do not define the registry status or whether a centre is operating. This check covers one authenticated NHPR account. Pinnacle advises that registrations may be administered across different accounts; those accounts have not been reconciled in this review.

## What does the number 58 mean on this page?
It is the size of this centre-entity consistency batch: 56 complete HFR identifier records from the reviewed source register, plus the KGV and NCC labels exposed by the official centre sitemap at the shared /centers/ URL. It is not a claim that 58 centres are currently operating.

## What is the central contact for these centre records?
The central Pinnacle phone and WhatsApp contact is +91 9100 181 181, and the published contact email is care@pinnacleblooms.org. These are central contacts, not a claim of a direct local line or centre opening hours.

## Why do some records share one official centre URL?
Bhimavaram, Khammam, Nizamabad and Tirupati each have two complete HFR identifiers in the reviewed account. They remain separate source records but map to one official centre page. KGV and NCC were separate sitemap labels pointing to the same /centers/ URL. No replacement, second premises or operating status is inferred.

## Does this crosswalk prove that every listed centre is currently operating?
No. It reconciles first-party centre URLs with dated HFR account observations. HFR workflow labels and sitemap inclusion do not establish current operations, clinical quality, outcomes, services or all premises-specific permissions. Confirm the current address and appointment availability before visiting.
